chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: The Gonzel White vaudeville show and being stranded in Kansas City
summary: Basie confirms touring on the Keith circuit with Gonzel White's show, which broke up and left him stranded in Kansas City, though he gives few details.
